To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) PSO J0435+02 is a nearby T8 dwarf, the first such object discovered in a large-scale search for T dwarfs; and (2) PSO J0447+02 is a known T dwarf that we have confirmed with near-IR spectroscopy.
we have discovered a T8 dwarf in the immediate solar neighborhood with a high tangential velocity and have measured its parallax for the first time using Pan-STARRS 1 data.
the Pan-STARR1 3π Survey is a highly efficient tool for finding high proper motion objects and that the immediate solar neighborhood contains only a modest number of high proper motion T dwarfs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the discovery and characterization of T dwarfs.
the discovery and characterization of T dwarfs with very high proper motions and low Galactic latitudes.
the discovery, characterization and classification of T dwarfs and the search for new T dwarfs in the immediate solar neighborhood.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no T dwarf in the 10 pc volume of space that has a proper motion >0.5 year–1.
the T dwarf population of the Solar Neighborhood is complete down to a spectral type of about T8.
the solar neighborhood is not a reservoir of undiscovered late-T dwarfs, but it does not rule out the possibility that the local volume may contain a large number of undiscovered late T dwarfs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the immediate solar neighborhood does not appear to contain a large reservoir (≳100) of undiscovered T8 dwarfs.
we have discovered a T dwarf with the second highest proper motion among field T dwarps and the first T dwarf with a PS1-based parallax measurement.
the T dwarf proper motion search with PS1 + 2M + WISE is very successful.
The main takeaway from our work is that
PS1 is now a valuable tool for discovering and characterizing nearby T dwarfs, especially those with high proper motions and red colors.
the combination of the PS1, 2MASS and WISE surveys provides a powerful tool for finding high proper motion substellar objects in the solar neighborhood.
the PS1 3π Survey is now a powerful tool for the discovery and characterization of nearby ultracool dwarfs.
